name: CivicLens
description: Civic complaint web app for city residents, designed for mobile accessibility across Indian regional languages.

permissions.name: microphone
permissions.purpose: Turn spoken complaints into written text in the resident's chosen language (English, हिन्दी, తెలుగు, தமிழ், বাংলা, मराठी).

permissions.name: camera
permissions.purpose: Capture or attach photographs of road potholes, garbage heaps, water leaks, or broken streetlights directly from the phone.

permissions.name: geolocation
permissions.purpose: Accurately detect the resident's current coordinates and municipal ward for on-site problem resolution.

microphone.fallback: Manual text input with Indian script keyboard support

camera.fallback: File upload picker or photo-less submission

location.fallback: Manual landmark and street address entry
